findings: Planner artifact-inspection permission in main paper differs from appendix/public prompt and separate planning workspace. Article/deck distinguish design and implementation.

RoleBinding validates configuration, not filesystem enforcement. Codex Planner defaults read-only; OpenCode Planner denies tools; GameCraft QA writes a disposable copy while bubblewrap hides original/private paths and original-source hashes are checked. Explicit unisolated mode disclosed.

Vanilla Continuation same-session wording in main text exceeds appendix's guaranteed artifact and harness/model continuation; absent public experiment receipts cannot resolve shared conversation state.
Table 1 Dominance uses twelve cross-system configurations, while Figure 5 uses eleven Codex checkpoints. Baselines 22% and 27.33% cannot be merged as one accuracy trajectory.
Table 22 Lighthouse contradicts every-task ablation claim: Full HoH 80.90 versus no Warm-Start 81.50.
GameCraft subset extended an earlier fixed subset, not a fresh uniform sample. Main benchmark and GPT-5.6-Sol/Godot 4.7 Fusepoint case use different tools/settings.

Public Developer receipt only anchors source hashes and a separate unexposed detailed receipt. Removed unsupported six-path and self-reported PASS assertions; public Tester FAIL and blocked phase remain verifiable.
Algorithm walkthrough now puts pre-edit baseline before development. Optional Figures 12-16 gallery retains all originals without interrupting the main reading route.

terminology.article_quote: Artifact state A_t 是第 t 轮结束时实际保存的代码、配置、资源和项目元数据
Evidence state E_t 是验证记录：哪些行为已经有截图、操作回放（replay）、运行时状态记录（runtime trace）、日志或公开测试支持，哪些仍缺证据（gap）
PRD（Product Requirements Document）是公开的产品需求文档。Planner 把它拆成本轮开发文档 D_t：要做什么、怎样验收、哪些已通过功能不能改坏
从上一轮项目 A_(t-1) 继续开发（warm-start），读取需求与 D_t；只有它能写项目，先测旧版本，再修改和自测
